data.name: Lubnaht
data.gender_notes: Lubnaht is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'al-banaht' meaning 'the lights' or 'the moons'. This name signifies the light and beauty of the moon. The name Lubnaht carries the meaning “Light, Moon” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Lubnaht usually hope their child will grow to embody light, moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the beauty and rarity of one's inner self, encouraging self-reflection and appreciation
data.etymology: Lubnaht belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, Moon.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lubnaht total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
